question: Where’s the closest restaurant you hit on the way to L Bar Ranch, Seboyeta, NM from New Mexico Slaughter House, Albuquerque, NM?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%L Bar Ranch%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Seboyeta%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 1000 -- Buffer of 1000 meters around the straight-line path ) ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
